'''Brendon Smith''' (also published as '''Brandon Smith''')<ref name="dt-15668">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/15668 eloms beatdown everything even aleins], DeckTech (brendon "marcop1975" smith, 30 April 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/15668/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/15668/ GitHub Pages].</ref> (DeckTech handle '''marcop1975''') posted a [[Light]] [[Agents In The Court / No Love For The Empire|Agents In The Court]] list on DeckTech in April 2001. As Brandon Smith he played at [[February 2000 Lakewood tournament]] on 19 February 2000 with Troopers on the Death Star, according to Douglas Harvilla's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d263">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-02-19-tacoma-washington-2-19-00d263/ tacoma-washington-2-19-00], DeckTech (Douglas "Douglas" Harvilla, 19 February 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-02-19-tacoma-washington-2-19-00d263/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
